اذلعبا (form IVq)
# اِذْلَعَبَّا (iḏlaʕabbā) /ið.la.ʕab.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# اِذْلَعِبَّا (iḏlaʕibbā) /ið.la.ʕib.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
